Messages.Author: Petri Wessman
Messages.Body:
Quick question: I (and other people here) have assumed that Rastacourere
drops the target vampire's cap by one (along with reducing stealth and
votes). However, the card text is:

"(D) Put this card on a titled vampire. The vampire's title is worth 1 less
vote during referendums, and he or she gets -1 stealth when attempting
political actions. This vampire's capacity is reduced by 1. (A vampire's
capacity cannot go below 1.) A vampire may have only one Rastacourere."

Notice the text "This vampire's capacity...". Does "this" in the text refer
to the acting minion or the target vampire? Could actually be read either
way.

So what's the official word? I want confirmation before including it as
anti-Anson+Golconda tech in decks ;).

//Petri

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Petri Wessman" <nos...@orava.org> wrote in message
news:6f7Jd.662$0b4...@reader1.news.jippii.net...


"This minion" on a minion card on a minion refers to
the minion it is on, unless card text makes it clear
that it refers to the minion who played it, typically
by juxtaposing it with "the minion with this card"[0].

Cards played by vampires on other vampires that say
"Put this card on a vampire ... this vampire <blah>".:

Archon
Blood Hunt
Consignment to Duat
Deep Cover Agent
Kaymakli Barrier
Of Noble Blood

[0]As in the case with Melange.

Ok, thanks. That's what I thought but could not find the meta rule you quote
above anywhere -- so I thought it best to check.

Makes Rastacourere a very nice little card. Removing votes and stealth from
potential voters is always good, and in addition it can hose the
Golcondability (hooray for new words :) of an 8-cap. Most useful for vote
decks that have few permanent votes on the table, of course, but I can see
a case for putting this in quite a few decks.

Hmmm, how many "reduce other vampire's capacity" means are there in the game
now?

Rastacourere (permanent effect)
Violet Tremain's special (permanent effect)
Mind of a Child (temporary effect)

Anyone remember others or is that it? So the max you could drop a vampire's
cap is by 3 (with a very strange Violet Tremain + dem combat deck :).

//Petri

Wrath of the Inner Circle.

Violet's reduction is repeatable (once per combat), so there's
no limit.

You could also repeat Wrath if you pass "<Clan> Justicar" in
between to restore the title.
